top_signals.title: Apollo Is Focused on Investment Grade, De Giorgi Says
top_signals.summary: Diego De Giorgi, partner and head of EMEA at Apollo Global Management, says the firm is focused on the global industrial renaissance and is particularly focused on investment-grade and the short end of curve. Speaking to Anna Edwards at Bloomberg's Global Credit Forum in London, he also says he expects a higher rate environment in 2027 alongside what he describes as the largest capex cycle in history.  (Source: Bloomberg)
